description_en: Queries the statuses of multiple pipeline jobs or nodes at a time
description_zh: 批量获取工作流任务或节点的状态
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-runs-status --pipeline-runs flow-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfxq --nodes PipelineRunId=flow-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfxq NodeId=node-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfx1 --workspace-id 94800 --output-type DataSet --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunsStatus

parameters.description_en: The pipeline jobs that you want to query. You must configure PipelineRuns or Nodes. We recommend that you configure Nodes.
parameters.description_zh: 要查询的工作流任务列表，PipelineRuns参数与Nodes参数两选一，优先Nodes。
